{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scorp Club''' was a members-only club located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Membership was complimentary to passengers staying in the liner's suites, and membership could be bought for twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for passengers traveling in the deluxe staterooms. Other passengers could become members for one hundred and twenty-five credits. Membership of the club was only valid for the duration of the cruise.
